# Mars - AI-Readable Site Index

Mars is a Rust-powered interactive notebook platform for exploring ideas, executing code, and discovering possibilities.

## Site Overview

- **Name**: Mars
- **Tagline**: Explore ideas. Execute code. Discover possibilities.
- **Type**: Interactive notebook platform
- **Primary Language**: Rust
- **Native Format**: .mars files
- **Repository**: https://github.com/hieudoanm/mars

## Key Features

- Multi-language support: Rust, Python, R, Julia, C++
- Desktop application (Tauri-based)
- CLI for headless execution
- Rich output rendering (text, images, tables, charts, LaTeX)
- Jupyter compatibility (import/export .ipynb)
- MCP integration for AI assistants
- VS Code, Zed, JetBrains extensions
